description:
Use this when the user asks which Indian stocks had the most volume, turnover, trades, delivery percentage or the largest move on a given trading day. For today's movers within one index use get_top_movers.

Rank NSE securities on one trading day by a published number: volume, turnover, trades,
    delivery % or % change.

    `date` is an ISO date (default: the newest stored day). `metric`: volume (default) | turnover |
    num_trades | deliv_pct | pct_change. `direction`: desc (default) | asc. `limit` 1..100 (default
    25). `instrument_class`: equity (default, mainboard) | sme | fund_unit | all, so fund units and
    bonds do not crowd a volume list. `series` narrows to one NSE series such as EQ or BE. pct_change
    is (close - prev_close) / prev_close rounded to two places, the rule NSE uses to count advances
    and declines. Source: every row of NSE's daily bhavcopy. A sort of published numbers, not a
    recommendation. For movers within one index use get_top_movers.
name: get_market_ranking
title: Market ranking by day
